intro: We list {{count}} MBA / PGDM colleges in Tamil Nadu where our records show a highest package of at least ₹{{threshold}} lakh: SRM Institute of Science and Technology and Sathyabama.

Read these MBA colleges in Tamil Nadu with ₹50 lakh highest package by programme and year. IIM Trichy's official 2024-25 PGPM highest CTC is ₹43.94 LPA, which is below this cut, so it is no longer on this list.
listLead: IIM Trichy's official audited 2024-25 placement report lists a PGPM average CTC of ₹19.27 LPA and a highest of ₹43.94 LPA, both below this threshold, so the institute is not on this page.
snapshot: IIM Trichy is 16th in the official NIRF 2025 Management ranking. SRM Institute of Science and Technology is 56th. Sathyabama is not in that top 100.
SRM's qualifying row is a 2023 Master of Hospital Administration record, with an average of ₹5 LPA and a highest of ₹57 LPA. That is not a two-year MBA, and the gap is wide.

faqs.question: Which MBA colleges in Tamil Nadu with ₹50 lakh highest package are listed here?
faqs.answer: {{count}} colleges: SRM Institute of Science and Technology and Sathyabama. Each meets the threshold in our file, but the programmes differ. IIM Trichy's official 2024-25 PGPM highest of ₹43.94 LPA is below this cut.

faqs.question: What is IIM Trichy's NIRF rank, and why is it not on this list?
faqs.answer: IIM Trichy is 16th in the official NIRF 2025 Management ranking. Its official 2024-25 PGPM highest CTC is ₹43.94 LPA, which is below this threshold, so it is not listed here.

faqs.question: Is the SRM figure for an MBA?
faqs.answer: No. The qualifying row is a 2023 Master of Hospital Administration record, with an average of ₹5 LPA and a highest of ₹57 LPA. Check the official report for that exact programme.

faqs.question: Are these packages guaranteed for 2026?
faqs.answer: No. They are historical records. Use the latest official placement report for the programme you will join.
